links.outcome: Residual personal identifying information missed and over-redaction after LLM-based de-identification of clinical letters
links.effect: With Llama-3 70B, 98.05% of PII characters removed; 1.95% of PII missed and 0.85% of characters erroneously redacted.
links.quote: When evaluating the performance in relation to the number of characters manually identified as containing personal information and identifiable characteristics, our system missed only 1.95% of personal identifying information and erroneously redacted only 0.85% of the characters.

unlisted_practices: Local on-premise LLM deployment for de-identifying clinical free text

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an open-source pipeline (LLM-Anonymizer) using local LLMs to de-identify real-world clinical documents, but it only evaluates the baseline performance/accuracy of the models on this task without testing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
